title: Add minimap and current road identity HUD
acceptance: a compact always-available minimap uses the already-streamed compiled road centerlines/road metadata and shows the player's local surroundings plus heading without introducing a second city-map download path

the HUD identifies the nearest/current named street, avenue, boulevard, highway, ramp, or other road when source data supplies a name and shows a concise road-class label derived from source metadata rather than invented precision
the minimap provides enough surrounding road context to see nearby turns/connections while remaining visually subordinate to the main driving view
road identity updates remain stable near intersections and degrade gracefully when names/classes are missing or ambiguous
unit tests cover nearest-road identity selection and minimap coordinate projection, and browser verification records readability while driving the Manhattan fixture
